tasks.label: Start MCP servers
args: $envFile = Join-Path $PWD '.env'; if (Test-Path $envFile) { Get-Content $envFile | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\s*ESIOS_API_KEY=(.+)$') { $env:ESIOS_API_KEY = $matches[1] } } }; if (-not $env:ESIOS_API_KEY) { throw 'ESIOS_API_KEY was not found in .env' }; Start-Process -FilePath "$PWD\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -ArgumentList "-m ree.app" -WindowStyle Hidden -WorkingDirectory "$PWD"; Start-Process -FilePath "$PWD\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -ArgumentList "-m omie.app" -WindowStyle Hidden -WorkingDirectory "$PWD"; Start-Process -FilePath "docker" -ArgumentList "run --rm -i -e ESIOS_API_KEY=$env:ESIOS_API_KEY mcp/esios" -WindowStyle Hidden -WorkingDirectory "$PWD"; Start-Process -FilePath "docker" -ArgumentList "run --rm -i -e ESIOS_API_KEY=$env:ESIOS_API_KEY mcp/glossary" -WindowStyle Hidden -WorkingDirectory "$PWD"
